execution_policy: Do not invoke the experimental ABI until an official or independently audited SandboxSpec.fbs binding is available.

planned_test_matrix.required_result: request reaches the authorized origin only through the Aura proxy
TLS destination and CONNECT target remain bound to the execution grant
the sandbox can authenticate without embedding a bearer secret in the proxy URL, command line, environment, or logs
direct Winsock traffic that does not use the configured proxy is denied
UDP, QUIC, and direct DNS cannot bypass the configured proxy path
process-local proxy overrides and bypass lists cannot weaken the OS policy
all descendants remain under the same proxy enforcement and execution Job
redirects and hostname re-resolution cannot reach loopback, private, link-local, or cloud metadata targets
proxy loss or credential revocation closes active traffic and does not enable direct egress
process tree, Job, proxy state, credentials, profile state, handles, and temporary files are removed or revoked
